get.summary: Retrieve all line items of a proposal

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

name.description: Display name of the line item.

group_id.description: Line item group ID. Omit or leave empty to use the default group.

cost_item.description: Cost item associated with the line item. Provide custom pricing or omit to use a generic cost item based on type. When provided, the entire cost item is replaced (no partial updates). At least one of `cost_item.unit` or `type` must be provided so the line item's measurement basis is determined.

name.description: Display name of the cost item.

unit_labor.description: Labor time per unit, in the unit specified by labor_time_unit (e.g. minutes when labor_time_unit is MINUTES).

is_untaxed.description: Whether the item is excluded from tax.

id.description: Catalog item ID to link to an existing cost item. Omit or leave empty to create a new custom cost item from the provided fields.

symbol_id.description: Symbol ID for takeoff. Built-in: circle, square, empty. Custom: numeric document ID string.

parts.description: Sub-items (parts) of an assembly cost item. Empty for non-assembly cost items. On create, replaces the parts list copied from any referenced catalog item. Only valid when `type` is `Assembly` — providing parts with any other type is rejected with 400.

items.description: Cost item sub-item (part of an assembly).

name.description: Display name of the cost item.

unit_labor.description: Labor time per unit, in the unit specified by labor_time_unit (e.g. minutes when labor_time_unit is MINUTES).

is_untaxed.description: Whether the item is excluded from tax.

labor_factor.description: Labor difficulty factor applied to the cost item.

quantity.description: Quantity from the estimating table (manual entry). Updated when using estimating or takeoff tab.

tag.description: Optional tag for filtering or grouping.

type.description: How the line item quantity is measured (count, linear, area, etc.).

takeoff_quantity.description: Quantity measured in the takeoff tab (2D drawing and 3D model measurements combined). Read-only.

updated_at.description: The date and time when the line item was last updated.

x-changelog.summary: Introducing new endpoint to retrieve all line items of a proposal
x-changelog.description: This endpoint allows retrieving all line items of a proposal.

x-changelog.summary: Introducing new fields in the response
x-changelog.description: The response now includes new fields: item_cost, item_sales, labor_cost, labor_sales, profit and updated_at

x-changelog.summary: Removed based_on_item_id from line item cost item
x-changelog.description: The cost_item embedded in line item create, update, and get responses no longer exposes the based_on_item_id field. The field was undocumented for line items and is meaningful only for Cost Catalog endpoints.

x-changelog.summary: Sub-items (parts) exposed on line item cost item
x-changelog.description: The cost_item embedded in line item create, update, and get responses now includes a parts array. On create, providing parts replaces the parts list copied from any referenced catalog item. On update, providing parts replaces the entire parts list (omit to leave unchanged).

x-changelog.summary: Line item responses now include quantity and takeoff_quantity
x-changelog.description: Line item responses now expose quantity (renamed from count, representing manual quantity from estimating table) and takeoff_quantity (read-only quantity measured in the takeoff tab, combining 2D drawing and 3D model measurements).

post.summary: Create an estimate line item in the proposal
post.description:
Provide either `type` (e.g. `LINEAR`, `AREA`) or `cost_item.unit` (e.g. `FT`, `SQ_FT`); the other is inferred from what you supply.
If both are provided, they must be compatible or the request is rejected with 400.
            
Compatibility:
            
| `cost_item.unit`                              | Compatible `type`                                        |
|-----------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| `EA`, `MINUTES`, `HOURS`, `DAYS`, `WEEKS`, `MONTHS` | `COUNT`, `LINEAR_EACH`, `DESIGN`, `NONE`           |
| `LB`, `TON`, `GAL`                            | `COUNT`                                                  |
| `FT`, `YD`                                    | `LINEAR`, `LINEAR_WITH_DROP`, `LINEAR_AVG_WITH_DROP`, `LINEAR_EACH` |
| `SQ_FT`, `SQ_YD`, `SQUARE`, `CU_FT`, `CU_YD`  | `AREA`, `VERTICAL_AREA`                                  |
| `LUMP_SUM`                                    | `NONE`, `COUNT`                                          |
